shared_prefix.speaker: Melissa, a 24-year-old Spanish-Indonesian mix, pursuing her Masters degree.
shared_prefix.message: Actually, Elaine, your idea is a bit off. In our culture, bringing white lilies is traditional and symbolizes the right values. And speaking of values, I just...
